name: Tokura Tsubasa
source:
Tsubasa is a brave girl who is always bright and cheerful. Even though she is [url=/c1082]Mayu[/url]'s (younger) sister, her personality is the exact opposite of Mayu's.
Because Tsubasa has a lot of superficial knowledge about sex, she wants to know everything about any love affairs that are going around, or at least to hear and spread rumors about them. She worried that Mayu still doesn't have a boyfriend.
Tsubasa's hobby is playing video games. Even though they almost don't own any games, she is very at playing any video game.

Hobbies: Gaming.
Favorite Food: Her older sister's home cooking.

[Translated from [url=http://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/akiiro/chara.html]Akiiro Renka's official website[/url].]
